Use these unit summaries to see the whole computer-engineering pathway. Open the detailed curriculum roadmap for the complete sequence, or choose a published lesson from the sidebar.

::: {.callout-note title="Work in progress"}
Completed classroom materials are linked beside a concise implementation plan for the remaining engineering-preparation units. Earlier draft notes are preserved on the `archive/notes-before-refactor-2026-10-10` branch while they are reviewed.
:::

## Units at a glance

::: {.tej-download-grid}
::: {.tej-download-card}
### 0. Orientation and design

Design process, documentation, source attribution, privacy, and classroom routines.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-0)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 1. Numbers and units

Number systems, significant figures, engineering notation, metric prefixes, estimation, and calculator skills.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-1)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 2. Electrical fundamentals

Charge, voltage, current, resistance, sources, loads, alternating current, and direct current.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-2)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 3. DC circuit analysis

Ohm's law, power, series and parallel circuits, mixed networks, Kirchhoff's laws, dividers, and troubleshooting.

[Open Circuits](circuits/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 4. Building and measurement

Breadboards, schematics, simulation, multimeter use, measurement uncertainty, and comparison of predicted and measured results.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-4)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 5. Components and applied circuits

Sensors, batteries, capacitors, diodes, transistors, timers, motors, relays, and useful low-voltage circuits.

[Open the Electronics Lesson Library](electronics-library/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 6. Digital logic and inputs

Logic levels, stable switches, pull-ups, pull-downs, debouncing, gates, truth tables, and state.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-6)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 7. Fabrication and PCBs

Soldering, connectors, printed circuit boards, manufacturing files, enclosures, and fabrication.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-7)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 8. Computer systems

Computer components, power, assembly, startup, firmware, Linux installation, upgrades, repair, and reuse.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-8)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 9. Linux and basic networking

Linux desktop use, files, permissions, command line, software, connectivity, services, backup, and recovery.

[Open Linux and Operating Systems](linux-operating-systems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 10. Programming

Algorithms, variables, conditions, loops, functions, files, testing, debugging, and technical documentation.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-10)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 11. Microcontrollers

Protected inputs and outputs, sensors, timing, communication, actuators, state machines, and data logging.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-11)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 12. Networking and administration

Addresses, protocols, diagnostics, secure remote access, users, classroom services, and defensive administration.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-12)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 13. Data science and machine learning

Data preparation, visualization, regression, classification, model evaluation, uncertainty, and responsible use.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-13)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 14. Language models and applied AI

Tokens, prediction, prompting, grounding, evaluation, small models, and responsible artificial-intelligence use.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-14)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 15. Culminating projects

Requirements, planning, construction or simulation, testing, revision, evidence, and technical communication.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-15)
:::

::: {.tej-download-card}
### 16. Control systems and CNC

Open and closed loops, hysteresis, proportional and PID control, interlocks, state machines, motion, and CNC.

[Open the roadmap](curriculum/index.qmd#unit-16)
:::
:::
